models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description:
Channels represent the main entry points or marketplaces within the e-commerce platform.

Each channel defines its unique code and display name, enabling clear identification and management within the system.

Channels serve as organizational units that link to specific sections and categories to structure the shopping experience.

Soft deletion is supported to retain historical records while allowing content moderation and administrative control.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code identifying the channel, used for internal system references and API routing.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the channel as presented to customers and administrators.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel record was soft deleted; null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description:
Sections represent subdivisions or areas within a channel that group related categories and products.

Each section belongs to a single channel and serves to organize offerings logically for improved navigation and management.

Sections have unique codes within the system and support soft deletion for administrative purposes.

They track creation and update timestamps to support auditing and operational history.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the channel to which this section belongs. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code identifying the section for internal use and API access.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the section to show in the administrative interfaces and to customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null when the section is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_channel_categories
models.description:
Channel categories link specific categories to channels, defining the category organization within a particular channel context.

Each category linked to a channel may influence navigation, filtering, and presentation of products within that channel.

This table supports soft deletion to allow removal without losing historical relationships.

Timestamps track creation and update events for audit trails and system operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shopping mall channel. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to product category associated with this channel category. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel category record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description:
Configurations store key-value pairs representing system-wide settings and preferences.

Each configuration entry has a unique key to prevent duplicates and ensure unambiguous retrieval.

Configurations can be soft deleted to allow deactivation without data loss.

Timestamps for creation and updates are maintained for auditing and change tracking.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier key for the configuration setting.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value as a string. Interpretation is context-dependent.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null when configuration is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_guests
models.description:
Guest users who browse the platform without requiring authentication.

They have a minimal profile and are tracked primarily for session management and audit purposes.

Guest entities do not have login credentials and are intended for transient or anonymous usage.

Soft deletion is supported to allow recording of guest removal without losing historic session data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest_sessions
models.description:
Session records for guest users.

These track individual guest sessions including connection context such as IP address, referrer, and connection URL.

Sessions allow monitoring guest activity anonymously.

Sessions have a foreign key reference to the guest user.

Session expiry information is recorded for session lifecycle management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest user. {@link shopping_mall_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the connection origin.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the guest arrived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer users who have accounts to purchase products and manage their profiles.

Customers can manage multiple shipping addresses, perform purchases, submit reviews, and track order history.

Customer accounts include authentication credentials for login purposes.

Accounts support soft deletion for audit trails and historical integrity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for customer login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for customer authentication.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Customer's full name.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if account is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated customer users.

Each session tracks login information with IP, referrer, and connection URL.

Sessions help in managing multiple concurrent logins and auditing user activity.

Sessions reference the customer user via a foreign key.

Session expiry supports session lifecycle management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer user. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the customer session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the connection origin.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the customer arrived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Seller users who manage product listings and inventory.

Sellers have authentication credentials for platform login and operation.

Accounts track statuses such as active or suspended to control operational rights.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain historical data legally and operationally.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for seller login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for seller authentication.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Seller's registered business or personal name.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the seller account (e.g., active, suspended).

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Business workflow status to track seller lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated seller users.

Each session captures connection context for seller authentication and activity tracking.

Sessions are linked to the corresponding seller user.

Expiration timestamps are used for session lifecycle management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller user. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the seller session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the connection origin.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the seller arrived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrative users who manage the platform and oversee operational aspects.

Admins have authentication credentials and full access rights.

Their accounts track lifecycle statuses and support soft deletion for auditing.

Admin data supports enforcement of high-level access control policies.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for admin login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for admin authentication.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Admin user's full name.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the admin account (e.g., active, suspended).

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Business workflow status to track admin lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated administrative users.

Sessions track login activity and connection details for administrators.

Foreign key references ensure session linkage to the admin account.

Expiration timestamps indicate session validity periods.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin user. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the admin session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the connection origin.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the admin arrived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Products available in the shopping mall marketplace.

Represents the main catalog entries created and managed by sellers. Each product belongs to one or more categories, supports multiple SKUs as variants, and can be tracked through sales snapshots.

Includes essential metadata for display, grouping, and status management. Products may be soft-deleted.

References seller entities and category relationship via foreign keys from other components.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller entity who owns the product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business code identifying the product, used in UI and backend operations.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates if the product is currently active and visible in the catalog.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the product was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description:
Product categories used to organize and classify products in the shopping mall.

Supports hierarchical categorization for browsing and filtering.

Categories can have parent categories to form category trees.

Soft deletion is supported.

Primarily used to group products and facilitate search and navigation.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the parent category for hierarchical categorization. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name displayed to users.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique category code used in business operations.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the category was soft-deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_skus
models.description:
Stock Keeping Units representing specific variants of products.

Each SKU uniquely identifies a variant defined by a combination of attribute values, price, and inventory quantity.

SKUs are directly linked to products and manage seller-specific pricing and stock levels.

Supports soft deletion and auditing timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent product. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code used for inventory and order processing.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Sales price of this SKU variant.

plainFields.name: inventory
plainFields.description: Current inventory count for the SKU.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates if the SKU is currently active and available for sale.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the SKU was soft-deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_attributes
models.description:
SKU attribute definitions representing types of variant attributes.

Defines attributes like color, size, material, etc., which can be used in SKU options and values.

Attributes support soft deletion and auditing timestamps.

This supports extensible variant attribute management for products.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the attribute type, e.g., 'Color' or 'Size'.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code of the attribute for system reference.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the attribute's use cases.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attribute was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attribute was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attribute was soft-deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_attribute_values
models.description:
Individual values for SKU attributes.

Represents the selectable values for attribute types such as 'Red', 'Blue' for 'Color' or 'S', 'M', 'L' for 'Size'.

Links each value to an attribute and supports soft deletion and audit timestamps.

Used to define variants in SKUs consistently.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_attribute_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU attribute this value belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sku_attributes.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The specific value of the attribute, e.g., "Red", "XL".

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code representing this attribute value.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional details about this attribute value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the value was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this value.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking the soft deletion of this attribute value.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_option_groups
models.description:
Groups of SKU options that allow multiple selections under a variant.

Used to organize SKU options for complex variants with grouped choices.

Supports soft deletion and auditing timestamps.

Facilitates variant customization and pricing differentiation.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the option group, e.g., "Accessories", "Add-ons".

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code identifying the group.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the option group's purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the group's creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_options
models.description:
Individual SKU options belonging to option groups.

Represents selectable options that can be chosen under an option group, affecting SKU variation.

Supports soft deletion, indexing, and auditing timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_option_group_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU option group this option belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sku_option_groups.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the option, e.g., "Gift Wrap", "Extended Warranty".

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique code for the SKU option.

plainFields.name: price_adjustment
plainFields.description: Price adjustment amount applied when this option is selected; can be positive or negative.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the option.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_sales_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots capturing the state of products and sales at points in time.

Used for auditing, reporting, and trend analysis.

Denormalized to preserve exact historic state including product, SKU, pricing and inventory data at snapshot time.

Snapshot entities are append-only with created_at denoting the snapshot timestamp.

Do not modify snapshots after creation to ensure data integrity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product at snapshot time. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU at snapshot time. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: price_at_snapshot
plainFields.description: Sales price of the SKU at the snapshot time.

plainFields.name: inventory_at_snapshot
plainFields.description: Inventory count of the SKU at the snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was taken.

models.name: shopping_mall_shopping_carts
models.description:
Customer shopping carts storing active shopping sessions and associated customer references.

Each shopping cart belongs to exactly one authenticated customer, linking to their active customer session. The cart maintains creation and update timestamps.
Soft deletion is supported to allow retention of historical cart data without user visibility.

This entity serves as the primary container for items customers intend to purchase and supports multiple items per cart.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning customer. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer's active session during cart activity. Nullable if session expired or unknown. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion; NULL if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Items contained within a customer's shopping cart.

Each cart item references the parent shopping cart, the product, and the specific SKU variant selected for purchase.
Quantities are positive integers reflecting the desired purchase amount.

Timestamps track creation and updates for audit and synchronization.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shopping_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent shopping cart. {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product selected. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific SKU variant of the product. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the product SKU in the cart item.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; NULL if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Customer wishlists storing products customers are interested in purchasing later.

Each wishlist belongs to one authenticated customer and manages multiple wishlist items.
Soft deletion is supported to hide inactive wishlists but retain historical data.

Wishlists facilitate personalized shopping experiences and user engagement.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning customer. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer's active session at the time of wishlist activity. Nullable if unknown. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: User-defined name for the wishlist to identify it.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the wishlist.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; NULL if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Items contained within customer wishlists.

Each wishlist item references the parent wishlist, the product, and the specific SKU variant selected.

Timestamps track creation and updates, and soft deletion supports data lifecycle management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product in the wishlist item. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific SKU variant. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; NULL if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Orders placed by customers in the e-commerce shopping mall.

This model represents the main order entity containing customer references, order metadata, status, and amounts.
Orders are linked to customers and include totals, order numbers, and lifecycle timestamps.
Soft delete is supported to enable audit and moderation.

Business-critical fields cover order status transitions, payment status, and shipment tracking indicators.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique business order number for external reference.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status such as pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment status indicating whether payment is pending, completed, or failed.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount of the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for logical deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual items included in customer orders.

Each record represents a SKU included in an order with quantity, price, and status.
Order items are dependent entities managed through the parent order.

Manages detailed product SKU references, quantities, and prices at the time of ordering.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the order item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product SKU. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units for the SKU in this order item.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Unit price of the SKU at order time.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the order item, e.g., pending, shipped, returned.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payments
models.description:
Payments made for orders in the shopping mall platform.

Tracks payment transactions including amounts, payment methods, statuses, and timestamps.
Payments link to orders and manage success or failure details.
Soft delete supported for audit and rollback.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the related order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: payment_method
plainFields.description: Payment method used, e.g., credit card, bank transfer, digital wallet.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount paid in this transaction.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Payment status such as pending, completed, failed, refunded.

plainFields.name: transaction_id
plainFields.description: External payment transaction identifier from gateway.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the payment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for payment record.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Shipment records for orders in the shopping mall platform.

Tracks shipment status, shipping method, tracking numbers, and timestamps.
Shipments are linked to orders and enable shipment lifecycle tracking.
Soft deletion supported for shipment data management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order being shipped. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: shipping_method
plainFields.description: Shipping method or carrier name.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the carrier.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Shipment status such as pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update on shipment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for shipment.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellations
models.description:
Order cancellation requests submitted by customers.

Tracks cancellation reasons, statuses, and timestamps.
Related to orders and managed independently for audit and processing.
Supports soft delete for audit trail.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the cancellation request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the related order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer requesting cancellation. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided for cancellation by the customer.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Cancellation request status such as pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for cancellation request.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_refunds
models.description:
Refund requests and processing related to customer orders.

Tracks refund amounts, statuses, and administrative approval workflows.
Linked to orders and customers for complete audit and payment reconciliation.
Supports soft deletion for audit purposes.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the related order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer requesting refund. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount requested for refund.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Refund status such as requested, approved, rejected, completed.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the refund request provided by the customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_coupons
models.description:
Defines marketing coupons for the shopping mall platform.

Each coupon includes its unique code, discount information, validity periods, and restrictions. Coupons are centrally managed to control promotional offers and marketing campaigns.

This table stores raw coupon data without usage logs, supporting creation, update, and deactivation. Soft deletion tracks removed coupons while preserving history for auditing.

Uniqueness is enforced on coupon code for quick lookup during order processing and validation.

plainFields.name: discount_value

plainFields.name: minimum_order_amount

plainFields.name: maximum_discount_amount

plainFields.name: start_at

plainFields.name: end_at

plainFields.name: usage_limit

plainFields.name: status

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

Records each redemption of a coupon by a customer on an order.

Tracks which customer redeemed which coupon, tied to a specific order, with timestamps and redeemed discount amount.

This table supports audit trails and prevents reuse where restrictions apply. Logical deletion is supported for maintaining data integrity and compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_coins
models.description:
Customer coin balances within the shopping mall platform.

This model tracks the current balance of digital coins associated with each customer in a specific mall channel. It provides essential information for loyalty and reward programs that utilize coins as a currency.

Each coin record is linked to a specific customer and mall channel, enabling accurate allocation and querying across multiple marketplaces or sales channels. The balance field represents the current amount of coins the customer holds.

Soft deletion is supported via the deleted_at field to allow reversible removal and auditing. Temporal fields track creation and update timestamps to support audit trails and synchronization.

Mileage transactions recording all changes to customer mileage accounts.

This model captures every transaction related to mileage points within the shopping mall platform. Each transaction links to the customer involved and includes transaction type, amount, and references to related entities like orders or payments when applicable.

Temporal fields ensure accurate logging of transaction creation and updates, while soft deletion via deleted_at supports audit and recovery.

Transaction types include earning, spending, cancellations, and administrative adjustments, allowing robust tracking and reporting of mileage point flows.

This table records all inquiries raised by registered customers. Each inquiry is linked to the customer who created it and their active session at the time of submission. The inquiries represent independent support tickets requiring management, tracking, and resolution workflows.

The table supports soft deletion for audit trails and includes status fields to track inquiry lifecycle stages such as open, pending, resolved, and closed. Timestamps indicate creation and modification.

Status indexing allows efficient retrieval and filtering by inquiry state.

User favorite products in the shopping mall platform.

This table captures the relationship between customers and their favorite products. Each record links a customer to a specific product they have marked as favorite. The table tracks the customer session when the favorite was marked or updated.
